description.value: A Mexican restaurant in Stewart, BC, operated under the name El Tostador (formerly Toastworks). The restaurant offers outdoor seating and accommodates large vehicles. Washroom facilities are available on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook website for El Tostador could not be fetched (status=400), so evidence comes primarily from OSM tags. The OSM record is recent (check_date 2025-09-26) with looks_closed=false, confirming the business operates. OSM explicitly confirms toilets=yes, outdoor seating, and large vehicle access. Most cyclist amenities (bike parking, water refill, charging) are not mentioned in OSM and cannot be verified without website access.
concerns: Website fetch failed (status=400) — unable to verify business details from primary source; amenity claims rely solely on OSM tags
Name discrepancy: OSM old_name field lists 'Toastworks', indicating a recent rebrand
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed via recent OSM survey. Website unavailable to verify details, but the business legitimately serves the touring cyclist community.
